answer: No guess needed: init runs SLDBBootstrap.ensure_machine_ready (bootstrap.py:59-60), called only from main.py:_bootstrap (154) and main.py:_init (164). ensure_machine_ready can pass allow_install=True there; no main.py flag edit required.

Default false is the only reading consistent with the Goal ('true only from bootstrap and init'); the direct ensure_sldb_available sites in main.py keep the default and ensure_machine_ready passes True.

Install runner is SLDBBootstrap._run (bootstrap.py:202; called at :42 for 'pip install -e'), or subprocess.run (:203). Spy on 'deskops.bootstrap.SLDBBootstrap._run'. The cited span 36-62 is off: ensure_sldb_available is bootstrap.py:31-57.

_sldb_importable calls importlib.util.find_spec('sldb') (bootstrap.py:176). monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules,'sldb',None) makes find_spec return None (importlib/util.py:57-60); or monkeypatch _sldb_importable/find_spec directly.

main() returns int (main.py:373-375) and re-raises SystemExit instead of converting it. Existing tests already assert main([...]) == 1 (tests/test_doctor_model_registration.py:29), so Test B should do the same.

Keys are class names, matching store_index 'name': SLDB registers name=model_type.__name__ (../sldb/src/sldb/cli/commands/model_add.py:93; store/models/model_entry.py:5). MODEL_REFS values are 'deskops.models:<Class>' (bootstrap.py:14-26).

Test A's equality cannot pass: init also runs ensure_lifecycle_graph (main.py:179-181), whose init_relations (lifecycle.py:216) registers sldb's RelationTypeDoc/RelationDoc, so the store holds 17 names, not the 15 from __all__ minus the two bases. Fix: filter to the deskops subset, or expect the 2 extra relation names.
